fullDescription: A warm aurora-gradient SaaS pricing page with a giant serif headline, frosted-glass tiers flanking a lifted purple 'most popular' card, and a live monthly/annual toggle.
prompt:
## Resumo
A warm, frameless responsive SaaS pricing page with an oversized serif headline and a single dramatic top-to-bottom aurora gradient (peach to pink to violet) that bleeds the hero straight into a 3-tier card row. The middle 'most popular' tier is a deep-purple gradient card that lifts above its frosted-glass neighbors, a pill billing toggle live-swaps monthly/annual pricing, a glassy promo band sits below the cards, and a clean cream FAQ + dark footer close the page.

## Estilo Visual
Use a warm aurora gradient background that runs vertically from cream into peach, pink, and finally deep violet, built from layered radial glows. Background base cream #fdf8f3 stepping to #fbeede, #f4cfdf, #9b7cf0; radial accent glows in peach rgba(255,184,108,0.55), pink rgba(255,107,168,0.45) and a large purple bloom rgba(123,79,255,0.85) anchored bottom-center. Ink/text color #1b1430 on light areas, white on dark. Featured card is a 155deg linear gradient #2a1758 -> #4423a8 -> #6b34d6. Recurring accent hues: orange #ff8a5c / #ff7a45 / #ff6b3d, hot pink #ff5fa0 / #ff3d8b, violet #7b4fff, gold #ffd166 / #ffc36b, teal #4cc9f0, success green #22b07d (checks on light cards) and mint #7bf0c4 (checks on the dark card). Typography: display serif 'Fraunces' at heavy weights (800-900, with the keyword set in italic gradient-clipped text) for headlines and prices; 'Inter' for all body, labels and buttons. Add a faint fractal-noise grain overlay (~4% opacity, mix-blend overlay) over the gradient, subtle backdrop-blur on the nav and glass cards, and soft long-throw colored drop shadows under cards (e.g. 0 24px 60px -30px rgba(40,20,80,0.35), featured 0 40px 90px -30px rgba(76,34,168,0.7)). Buttons and chips are fully rounded pills; cards use 28px corner radius.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (h ~68px) with backdrop-blur and a translucent cream background plus a hairline bottom border. Left: a gradient rounded-square logo mark (orange->pink->violet) with a lotus icon next to a heavy serif wordmark ('Promptbloom'). Center (desktop only): text links 'Library' and 'Templates' with small caret-down icons, plus 'Showcase' and a bolded current 'Pricing'. Right: a 'Log in' text link, a pill outline 'Talk to us' button, and a solid dark ink pill CTA 'Start free' with a right-arrow icon. Secondary links collapse on small screens.

### Trust row + hero headline
Centered above the headline, a small social-proof row: 4 overlapping gradient avatar circles with cream rings, then muted text 'Trusted by 31,400+ designers & builders' with the number bolded. Below it a very large centered serif headline (clamping from ~56px mobile to ~96px desktop, weight 900, tight leading ~0.95): 'Pricing that blooms with you', where the word 'blooms' is italic and filled with an orange->pink->violet gradient clip. Under it a centered muted subhead (~17-19px, max-width ~36rem) reassuring users they can grow into the next plan.

### Billing toggle
A centered horizontal billing switch: 'Monthly' label (muted), a pill toggle (~60x32px) with a white knob that slides ~28px and turns the track violet #7b4fff when annual is active, an 'Annual' label (bold), and a small violet 'Save 20%' pill. Toggling live-updates the featured price and its caption (annual $15 / '$19 month-to-month' vs monthly $19 / 'Save 20% on annual').

### Pricing card row (3 tiers)
A 3-column pricing grid (28px radius cards, ~28px gap) that reflows to 2 then 1 column on smaller screens, top-aligned. Tier 1 'Sprout' (free): frosted white glass card, sparkle icon, '$0 forever', muted note, outline pill 'Start free' CTA, and a 4-item feature list with green check-circle icons (50 prompt copies/mo, browse full library, 1 collection, community support). Tier 2 'Bloom' (FEATURED, center): deep-purple gradient card lifted slightly above the others (negative top margin on desktop), with a centered gradient 'Most popular' badge tab overlapping the top edge, soft blurred color orbs inside, a tulip icon, big '$15 / mo' price (data-swappable to $19), 'Billed annually' caption, a solid WHITE pill CTA 'Get Bloom', and a 5-item feature list with mint check icons (Unlimited copies, AI remixing & variants on canvas, unlimited collections & exports, premium/early-access packs, priority support). Tier 3 'Orchard' (enterprise): frosted white glass card, tree icon, a word-price 'Let's talk', a solid dark ink pill 'Contact sales', and a 5-item green-check list (everything in Bloom, shared team libraries & roles, private packs & brand kits, SSO/SCIM/audit logs, dedicated success manager).

### Promo band
Below the cards, a centered rounded glass band (max-width ~56rem, dark translucent ink #1b1430 at ~35% with backdrop-blur and a faint white border): left side a gradient rounded gift-icon tile plus a heavy white serif heading 'Students & first-year founders bloom free.' with a muted supporting line; right side a solid white pill CTA 'Claim the free year' with arrow. Stacks vertically and centers on mobile.

### FAQ section
A separate cream-background section: centered heavy serif heading 'Questions, answered', a muted line with a violet 'Ping us' link, then a max-width ~48rem accordion of native <details> rows separated by hairline dividers. Each summary is a bold ~17px question with a plus icon that rotates 45deg into an x when open; the first item is open by default. Questions cover what counts as a prompt copy, switching plans, monthly vs annual, and the founder free year.

### Footer
A dark ink #1b1430 footer with white/70 text: left the gradient logo mark + 'Promptbloom' wordmark, center a row of quiet links (Library, Docs, Privacy, Status), right a faint copyright line. Stacks vertically and centers on mobile.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Billing toggle (monthly/annual) — A pill switch with a spring-eased sliding knob that live-swaps the featured tier's price and caption and turns the track violet when annual is selected, paired with a 'Save 20%' chip.
Build a ~60x32px rounded pill toggle with a 24px white knob. Default state is annual: track violet #7b4fff, knob translated ~28px right, featured price shows $15 and caption 'Billed annually. $19 month-to-month.' Off state: track ink/15 grey, knob at left, price $19 and caption 'Billed monthly. Save 20% on annual.' Animate the knob with a springy cubic-bezier(.4,1.3,.5,1) ~0.28s transition and store the two price values as data attributes that JS swaps on click.

### Featured (Most popular) tier card — The center pricing card rendered as a saturated purple gradient that visually outranks the two frosted-glass tiers: it sits higher, has an overlapping gradient badge, internal glow orbs, and inverted (white) text + CTA.
Make the middle card a 155deg gradient #2a1758 -> #4423a8 -> #6b34d6 with white text, lifted above neighbors via a small negative top margin on desktop, a 1px white/10 ring, and a heavy purple drop shadow. Add a centered 'Most popular' pill badge in an orange->pink->gold gradient overlapping the top edge, two large blurred color orbs (pink + cyan) bleeding inside the rounded clip, mint #7bf0c4 check icons in the feature list, and a solid WHITE pill CTA with a dark label so it pops against the purple.

### Gradient-clipped italic keyword — A single emphasis word inside the serif headline filled with a left-to-right orange->pink->violet gradient via background-clip:text.
Set one headline keyword (e.g. 'blooms') in italic Fraunces and fill it with a linear gradient from #ff6b3d via #ff3d8b to #7b4fff using background-clip:text and transparent text color, leaving the surrounding words solid ink.

### Frosted glass tier cards — The free and enterprise tiers are semi-transparent white cards with backdrop-blur so the aurora gradient glows softly through them.
Render the non-featured tiers as bg-white at ~85% opacity with backdrop-blur, a subtle white/70 border, 28px radius, and a soft long-throw shadow 0 24px 60px -30px rgba(40,20,80,0.35), so the colored gradient behind them remains faintly visible.

## Notas Especiais
This is a frameless, fully responsive HTML/Tailwind page, not a fixed-canvas mockup: the pricing grid reflows 3->2->1 columns and the nav is sticky. Built with the Tailwind Play CDN, Fraunces + Inter via Google Fonts, and Iconify (Phosphor icon set, data-icon='ph:*'). The whole hero+pricing area shares one continuous aurora gradient so the cards appear to float in it rather than sitting on separate section backgrounds. Honors the brand voice in the copy (warm, human, no em-dashes). Vanilla JS drives the billing toggle by swapping data-attribute prices.
